prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer sign in after pet selection: Move the sign-in step after pick_friend so users build emotional connection to their chosen pet before registration. (why: Sign in conversion is 72.9% early on; deferring sign-in until after companion pick increases motivation to complete account creation.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Add desktop controls walkthrough screen: Introduce a dedicated screen right before home_intro explaining how to hide, summon, and control the pet. (why: Multiple support emails highlighted user confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop environment check interactive sub-flow: Add an automated desktop render verification animation and prompt during the waiting screen step. (why: Support tickets reported pets not displaying on desktop or app failing to open upon onboarding completion.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account cloud save hint on sign in: Add explicit note clarifying that signing in preserves pet state and prevents pet resets across re-logins. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or being reset after signing in again.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Carousel layout for path selection screen: Switch choose_path screen layout to interactive carousel with mascot visual badges for each adoption path. (why: choose_path step exhibits a high mean time of 514s despite median 8s, indicating confusion on path selection.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo upload quality tips and preview guide: Add photo guidelines and advice component on upload_photos screen to help users provide clear inputs. (why: Users experienced custom pet generation failures and unexpected visual bugs after photo upload.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop ready background alert notification: Enable desktop notification toggle and ready sound cue on waiting screen so users can minimize the app. (why: Extremely high mean wait time (2336s) leads to lost users unless they can minimize and get notified when ready.)
7: [finish, layout] Stage layout celebration on final home intro: Rebuild home_intro with stage layout featuring official companion seal badge and launch action button. (why: Final onboarding conversion drops to 64.8% at finish step, requiring a prominent final launch signal.)
